changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionType_backup') BEGIN drop table dbo.FusionType_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionType_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionType_backup]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(50000,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
